en.headline: Fine and hot weekend expected as anticyclone holds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts mainly fine and dry conditions with daytime temperatures reaching 32 to 33 degrees over Saturday and Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an anticyclone aloft would continue to bring generally fine and hot weather to Guangdong over the weekend.

On Saturday, the weather is expected to be fine, dry and very hot during the day, with temperatures ranging from 27 to 33 degrees Celsius. Winds will be east to northeast force 3 to 4, and the chance of significant rain remains low.
Sunday is forecast to see sunny periods, remaining dry and hot by day with temperatures of 27 to 32 degrees. Isolated showers may develop later. Winds will ease to east to northeast force 2 to 3.

The Observatory advised the public to take precautions against the heat and to drink plenty of water. The outlook for early next week points to a few showers and sunny intervals as the monsoon moderates.

zh.headline: 周末天晴酷熱 最高氣溫33度
zh.dek: 天文台預料高空反氣旋持續影響，周六至周日大致天晴乾燥，日間酷熱，氣溫介乎27至33度。
body: 香港天文台表示，高空反氣旋會在未來一兩日繼續覆蓋華南，該區普遍晴朗，日間乾燥及酷熱。
周六（19日）預料天晴，日間乾燥及酷熱，氣溫27至33度，吹東至東北風3至4級，顯著降雨概率低。
周日（20日）部分時間有陽光，日間乾燥及炎熱，氣溫27至32度，稍後局部地區有驟雨，吹東至東北風2至3級。
天文台提醒市民注意防暑，多喝水。下周初隨着季候風緩和，預料有幾陣驟雨及短暫陽光。
